dedupe_keys.name: vibration data from 37 story building in bangkok during 7 7mw earthquake on 28 march 2025

description: Vibration Data from 37-story Building in Bangkok During 7.7Mw Earthquake on 28 March 2025. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Nakhorn Poovarodom, Amorntep Jirasakjamroonsri (Thammasat University). This dataset contains floor acceleration responses recorded during the Mw 7.7 earthquake on 28 March 2025 from the top floor of a 37-story reinforced concrete building using a low-cost TUSHM sensor system. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
